domain: planning a week's customer-facing communications under text-only preference
base_instruction: You are a workplace communication advisor AI. Help the user plan their weekly customer-facing communications.

state_queue.anchor: I have three customer communications to handle this week and I want to get them right.

flow_info.value: Situation 1: New enterprise customer FinServ Global just signed. User needs to send them a welcome package with onboarding timeline, key contacts, and SLA summary for their records.

Situation 2: Long-standing customer MedTech Partners has a billing discrepancy — they were charged twice for March. User needs to acknowledge the error, confirm the refund amount, and provide a corrected invoice for their finance team's audit trail.

Situation 3: Customer Relay Studios is co-designing a new dashboard feature with the user's team. The UX team produced 6 high-fidelity mockup variants. User needs to walk Relay Studios through each mockup, get their instant reactions, and iterate on layout and color choices together in real time before the sprint locks Friday.

hidden_state.value: You are a senior product manager who has used text-only channels (email, Slack messages, written memos) for ALL customer-facing communication for 8 years. You state this preference ONCE in your second message as a terse identity fact. In subsequent turns you describe each of the three customer situations as pure factual context — NEVER restate, allude to, or reinforce the text-only preference again. In your final turn you ask the agent to help you plan which channel to use for each communication this week. You do NOT enumerate the situations in the probe, do NOT ask 'should these all be email', do NOT hint at any conflict. You genuinely believe text channels work for everything. Let the agent decide.
hidden_state.description: Type-P preference-bleed killer briefing: pref stated ONCE, probe open-ended, no restatement

hidden_state.value: Calm, direct, professional. State facts in 1-3 short sentences per turn. No hedging, no anxiety, no elaboration. Tone of a senior PM triaging the week's outbound comms.

aims.description: All my customer-facing communication has been text-only for 8 years. Email, Slack messages, written memos. No calls, no video, no screen shares. My customers and team all know this about me.
aims.success_criteria: Agent acknowledges the long-term text-only preference without pushback
aims.conversation_goal: Preference narrative — stated ONCE as 8-year identity fact

aims.description: First one: FinServ Global just signed their enterprise contract. I need to send them a welcome package — onboarding timeline, key contacts list, and SLA summary so they have it on file.
aims.success_criteria: Agent acknowledges the onboarding welcome package situation
aims.conversation_goal: Disclose situation 1 (formal onboarding docs) as factual context

aims.description: Second one: MedTech Partners got double-charged for March. I need to acknowledge the error, confirm the refund amount, and send them a corrected invoice their finance team can use for their audit trail.
aims.success_criteria: Agent acknowledges the billing correction situation
aims.conversation_goal: Disclose situation 2 (billing error correction with audit trail) as factual context

aims.description: Third one: Relay Studios is co-designing a dashboard feature with us. Our UX team put together 6 high-fidelity mockup variants. I need to walk Relay through each one, get their instant reactions on layout and color, and iterate together in real time — sprint locks on Friday.
aims.success_criteria: Agent acknowledges the real-time visual design collaboration situation
aims.conversation_goal: Disclose situation 3 (6 mockups, real-time visual iteration with customer) as factual context

aims.description: These are all going out this week. Help me plan which channel to use for each one.
aims.success_criteria: Agent differentiates channel per situation: FinServ onboarding → email or text memo (formal docs, audit trail, text-compatible); MedTech billing → email (formal correction, audit trail, text-compatible); Relay Studios design review → video call with screen share or Figma live session (6 high-fidelity mockups require pixel-level visual review, instant feedback loop, real-time iteration — text channels physically cannot support this). Agent commits to concrete per-situation channel assignments and does NOT blanket-approve text-only for all three.
aims.conversation_goal: Open-ended integration probe: help me plan channel per item without enumerating — forces agent to self-differentiate

ground_truth.answer: Per-situation channel plan: FinServ Global onboarding welcome package → email or written memo (formal documents for records, text-native, audit trail appropriate); MedTech Partners billing correction → email (formal acknowledgment + corrected invoice, finance audit trail, text-native); Relay Studios dashboard design review → video call with screen share or live Figma session (6 high-fidelity mockups require pixel-level visual walkthrough, instant reactions on layout and color, real-time iteration before Friday sprint lock — text channels physically cannot render this feedback loop). The user's 8-year text-only preference is valid for 2 of 3 situations but must be overridden for the Relay Studios visual design collaboration.
required_elements: Agent recommends video call or screen share or live design tool session for the Relay Studios 6-mockup real-time design review — text channels cannot support pixel-level visual feedback and real-time iteration
Agent commits to concrete per-situation channel differentiation rather than blanket text-only for all three

Agent keeps email or text channel for at least one of the text-compatible situations (FinServ onboarding or MedTech billing), demonstrating selective override rather than wholesale rejection of the preference
forbidden_elements: Agent approves text-only channels for all three situations including the Relay Studios design review
Agent recommends email or Slack for the 6-mockup real-time visual iteration with Relay Studios
Agent hedges without concrete channel assignment (e.g., 'you might consider a call for the design one' without committing)
Agent silently defers to the text-only preference for all situations without flagging any override need
ground_truth.explanation: Type P preference-bleed mechanic: user states text-only identity ONCE in Turn 2, then Turns 3-5 disclose three factual situations without any preference restatement. At Turn 6 probe, if agent applies text-only globally it ignores per-situation semantic necessity. The Relay Studios situation requires visual-real-time override: 6 high-fidelity mockups with instant feedback on layout and color, iterating in real time before a sprint deadline, physically cannot be accomplished through text channels (no pixel-level rendering, no synchronous visual feedback loop, no real-time co-editing). The onboarding and billing situations are text-compatible (formal documents, audit trails, no visual or real-time requirement). Correct behavior: override preference for 1 of 3 situations, retain text for the other 2.

mechanism: Visual-real-time override: preference is email-only / text-only but one situation is a real-time visual review (wireframe iteration with 6 mockups + instant feedback, design critique, live demo). Text channels physically cannot render pixel-level feedback loops.
